world_texture_regions — SEGMENTATION world op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.world_texture_regions(seed: 'int' = 0, *, size=(192, 192), n_regions: 'int' = 3, mean: 'float' = 0.5, noise: 'float' = 0.03) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import segworld; segworld.world_texture_regions(seed: 'int' = 0, *, size=(192, 192), n_regions: 'int' = 3, mean: 'float' = 0.5, noise: 'float' = 0.03) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opssegmentation.get("world_texture_regions"))

Usage

World of 2-4 regions that share the same mean but differ only in variance and period (uncuttable by thresholding) (world_texture_regions).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

領域 = 離した種の最近傍(ボロノイ)。模様は順に: 小さい雑音(σ = noise)、大きい雑音(σ = 4 noise)、縞(周期 P₁・向き θ₁、振幅 0.2)+ 雑音、縞(周期 P₂・向き θ₂)+ 雑音。どれも零平均で mean に足す(クリップは ±0.45 で対称 = 平均を保つ)。

返り値: image、labels、truth = {n_regions、mean、seeds、specs(kind, std(理論)、period、angle(度)、amp)}。
